headword: {初等教育|しょとうきょういく}

definitions.explanation: The first stage of formal education, covering the basic knowledge and skills taught to children, typically at elementary school level.

examples.japanese: {初等教育|しょとうきょういく}は{六年間|ろくねんかん}だ。
{初等教育|しょとうきょういく}の{充実|じゅうじつ}が{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
この{国|くに}では{初等教育|しょとうきょういく}の{普及率|ふきゅうりつ}がまだ{低|ひく}い。
examples.english: In this country, the coverage rate of elementary education is still low.

notes:
{初等教育|しょとうきょういく} refers to the first stage of formal education — in Japan, the six years of {小学校|しょうがっこう} (elementary school, ages 6–12).

USAGE:
A formal term used in educational policy, academic research, and official documents. In everyday conversation, {小学校|しょうがっこう}の{教育|きょういく} is more natural.

JAPANESE EDUCATION LEVELS:
- {初等教育|しょとうきょういく}: elementary education (6 years)
- {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}: secondary education ({中学校|ちゅうがっこう} 3 years + {高校|こうこう} 3 years)
- {高等教育|こうとうきょういく}: higher education ({大学|だいがく}, etc.)

RELATED WORDS:
- {義務教育|ぎむきょういく}: compulsory education (covers elementary + middle school in Japan)
- {就学|しゅうがく}: school enrollment
